jp:
「あっ桃太郎さんだ！
　また　旅を　しているんですか？」
en: "Oh, it's Momotaro-san! Are you traveling again?"

"Momotaro-san! Are you looking for a {bb}Boat Ticket{ww}?"{KP}"Ta-daaa! Believe it or not, I've got a {bb}Boat Ticket{ww}!"{KP}"My family said they didn't need it anymore, so they gave it to me!"{KP}"It's my precious treasure!"{KP}"But just once, I'd love to see lots and lots of {bb}Dialect Cards{ww}!"{KP}"So if you show me the {bb}Dialect Cards{ww} you've got, Momotaro-san, I might just give you the {bb}Boat Ticket{ww}."{KP}"But five or six won't cut it!"{KP}"You've gotta show me at least 20!"

jp:
「あっ！
　いっぱい　持っていますね！
　桃太郎さんは！」{KP}
　
「ちょっと　見せてくださ～い！」
　
　{KP}
「ふ～ん
　こんな　カードが　あるの！」
　{KP}
「あっ！
　この　カード　おもしろ～い！」
　{KP}
「ありがとう　桃太郎さん！
　おもしろかったわ！
　お礼に　{bb}乗船券{ww}を　あげるね！」
en: "Oh! You've got loads of them, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"Let me have a looook!"{KP}"Hmmm, so there are cards like this!"{KP}"Oh! This card is so fuuunny!"{KP}"Thank you, Momotaro-san! That was fun! As thanks, here's the {bb}Boat Ticket{ww}!"

jp:
「アタイも　がんばって
　{bb}方言カード{ww}を　集めようかしら！」
en: "Maybe I'll try my best to collect {bb}Dialect Cards{ww} too!"
